title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage: Investigation Allowance on Final Claim Credits
content:
The investigation allowance credited with a Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage final credit follows the time from the claim's notice date to its resolution date.

**20.00** applies when that time is more than 90 calendar days for a new-account, point-of-sale or foreign-initiated transaction, or more than 45 calendar days for any other transaction.

**8.00** applies when it is not, but is more than 20 business days for a new-account transaction, or more than 10 business days for any other transaction.

**Nothing** applies otherwise.

- A new-account transaction is one that posted no more than 30 calendar days after the account's first deposit date.
- A point-of-sale transaction is a purchase.
- A foreign-initiated transaction is one marked as a foreign transaction.
- Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

## Hypothetical cases

| Transaction | Notice to resolution | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| ATM withdrawal outside the United States, marked foreign, not new-account | 70 calendar days, 49 business days | 8.00 |
| domestic ATM withdrawal, not new-account | 70 calendar days | 20.00 |
| purchase posted 12 days after the first deposit date | 95 calendar days | 20.00 |
| purchase posted 12 days after the first deposit date | 26 calendar days, 18 business days | nothing |
